joinRule: Two records describe the same product when either they carry the same NPC, or their supplier resolves to the same Hub company AND their normalised product names are identical. A name that merely contains another is recorded as a candidate link and never merged.
readingRule: Sources are shown side by side, never merged into one value. Where two sources disagree, both are published with their own attribution — the disagreement is the intelligence. Only the 'independent' source (NHS Supply Chain's Information for Clinical Choice) measures every supplier the same way; 'manufacturer' is each supplier's own words about its own product.

Description.value: Europa S laryngoscope handles are made from high quality plastic and are single use to eliminate cross contamination issues. They have ergonomically designed for user comfort and ease of use and are compatible with ISO conventional fitting single use laryngoscope blades. They are supplied clinically clean in pouches and require 2 x C size dry cell batteries. The Europa S laryngoscope handles have been engineered to reduce hospital waste due to their low volume plastic construction. Product Code Description NPC Code DS.2940.350.10 Europa S Laryngoscope Handles Medium C FSM3521 Clear product branding with the CE mark and single use symbol Standard light, conventional ISO 7376 fitting compatible with conventional fitting single use blades Low volume plastic construction reduces plastic waste Supplied in boxes of 10 Supplied clinically clean in peel pouches We are committed to continuous improvement and we strive to provide you with products that exceed expectations. Please do not hesitate to contact us with any further questions that you may have regarding our Europa S laryngoscope handles or any other products from our extensive range and our dedicated customer support team will be happy to help. You can reach us by calling us on: +44 (0) 1268 297710 or by emailing us at: sales@timesco.com . REPUTABLE BRAND. As a family owned business, Timesco have been at the forefront of medical product design and innovation since 1964 and are recognised as one of the most progressive and innovative companies within the industry. We are proud to manufacture and supply an unrivalled portfolio of medical products to medical professionals in Anaesthesia, Surgery, Podiatry & General Medical. END USER SATISFACTION. It’s important that the end user is satisfied with the products that we supply. Description.value: A quick, simple and low cost solution to convert existing dry cell laryngoscope handles to a rechargeable version. Simply replace the dry cell batteries with the equivalent Timesco R engine, the Timesco R Engine Charger Insert ensures a secure fit into the ION-R charger. Timesco Code Description 3125.100.16 Timesco R Engine Charger Insert AA Size 3125.100.17 Timesco R Engine Charger Insert C Size The engines can convert Timesco reusable handles to a rechargeable system without special end caps or other modifications. (Excluding stubby handles). The batteries use Lithium Ion technology to provide quick charging in an ION-R charger, typically less than 2 hours for a full charge and deliver consistent and reliable power. Both engines (Medium C & Small AA) are guaranteed for 3 years. Adaptors are used to ensure the engines fit into the ION-R charger. REPUTABLE BRAND. As a family owned business, Timesco have been at the forefront of medical product design and innovation since 1964 and are recognised as one of the most progressive and innovative companies within the industry. We are proud to manufacture and supply an unrivalled portfolio of medical products to medical professionals in Anaesthesia, Surgery, Podiatry & General Medical. END USER SATISFACTION. It’s important that the end user is satisfied with the products that we supply. From concept through to design and manufacture, our aim is to deliver products made to exceed internationally recognised quality standards and customer expectations. CONVENIENT LOGISTICS. All of our products are available to order direct, alternatively we work with third party distributors including NHS Supply Chain, Bunzl and Squadron. The majority of our General Medical products are available across a number of NHS Supply Chain framework agreements. SALES SUPPORT. Description.value: Timesco R Engines – A quick, simple and low cost solution to convert existing dry cell laryngoscope handles to a rechargeable version. Simply replace the dry cell batteries with the equivalent Timesco R engine. Product Code Description 3115.150.20 Timesco R Engine Small (AA size), 2.5v 3115.150.50 Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size), 2.5v Timesco R engines are guaranteed for 3 years. The engines convert Timesco reusable handles to a rechargeable system. No special end caps/modifications required (excluding stubby handles). The batteries use Lithium Ion technology to provide quick charging in an ION-R charger, (typically takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles) and deliver consistent and reliable power. Adaptors/Inserts are used to ensure that both engine sizes fit into the ION-R charger. The ION-R charger is an innovative, patented (patent number 2494141), intelligent and efficient lithium recharger for use with ION-R engines and Timesco-R engines. Once engines are fully charged the recharger will switch to a low power mode to avoid using unnecessary electricity. Only the engine is inserted into the charger, reducing the risk of cross contamination from a handle to the charger. The ION-R charger (single and daisy chained) takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles. A fully charged Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size) will last approx. 2 hours The colour changing LED indicates the health of the battery and the charging cycle. Side plates can be removed to daisy chain 3 chargers together to receive power from a single power supply.

Description.value: The 300M hand held pulse oximeter can continuously monitor, spot check, replay the data in real time and display Sp02 plethysmograph. It can be widely applied in hospitals and clinics with up to 30 hours of continuous use. It is supplied with 3 x AA batteries and complete with a 3 year guarantee. Spare finger probes for the 300m pulse oximeter are available as follows: Adult (30kg>) : TDM-PO-305M / NPC Code : FBC307 Paediatric (10-50kg) : TDM-PO-306M / NPC Code: FBC308 Neonatal:(<3kg) : TDM-PO-307M / NPC Code: FBC309 REPUTABLE BRAND. As a family owned business, Timesco have been at the forefront of medical product design and innovation since 1964 and are recognised as one of the most progressive and innovative companies within the industry. We are proud to manufacture and supply an unrivalled portfolio of medical products to medical professionals in Anaesthesia, Surgery, Podiatry & General Medical. END USER SATISFACTION. It’s important that the end user is satisfied with the products that we supply. From concept through to design and manufacture, our aim is to deliver products made to exceed internationally recognised quality standards and customer expectations. CONVENIENT LOGISTICS. All of our products are available to order direct, alternatively we work with third party distributors including NHS Supply Chain, Bunzl and Squadron. The majority of our General Medical products are available across a number of NHS Supply Chain framework agreements. SALES SUPPORT. We have a dedicated external field sales team strategically located offering extensive coverage across the UK (Territory Manager details are available on request). We also have an internal sales/customer support team based at our head office in Basildon, Essex. Our sales and support team are available Monday to Friday from 9am to 5pm. Apnea : A cessation of airflow for ≥10 seconds.

Obstructive sleep apnea : The most common form of sleep disordered breathing (SDB). A partial or complete collapse of the upper airway caused by relaxation of the muscles controlling the soft palate and tongue.

Central sleep apnea : A type of sleep disorder that occurs when the respiratory control center in the brain fails to send a signal to the muscles that control your breathing during sleep. CSA causes you to repeatedly stop and start breathing during the night.

Mixed sleep apnea : A combination of OSA (absence of airflow but continued respiratory effort) and CSA (absence of airflow and respiratory effort). It often starts with central apnea episodes followed by obstructive apnea events.

Description.value: ResMed AirSense 11 Replacement Filters These filters are an alternative to the branded ResMed AirSense 11 filters. These are not made by ResMed but by Air Filtration Solutions and are made of a similar quality to the original ResMed filters. What’s the difference between the filters? Coarse filters : The reusable foam filter provides a strong barrier between your machine and particles to prevent them from entering your machine. These should be washed when necessary. Fine filters : The disposable hypoallergenic filter provides an additional layer of protection against allergens entering the CPAP system, so it is particularly beneficial for those with allergies affecting their respiratory system (eg. hayfever). When do I replace my filters? The white fine filter should be changed once a month or sooner if needed, and the black coarse filter should be changed every three months. The black coarse filters are reusable and should be washed when dirty. How do I replace my filters? On the back of your device is a small filter compartment; open this to remove the old filters and replace them with new ones. Why buy alternative filters? Our filters are often cheaper than the branded originals, even though they are of similar quality. Unlike the CPAP machine, there is nothing high-tech about foam and paper filters, so there is nothing to worry about compromising air quality. It could also be that you are placing an order for another item here anyway, so you might as well get some filters simultaneously to avoid packaging and postage costs.

Description.value: The Ambistik is a high-precision, USB-based module designed to monitor environmental conditions temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity with total accuracy. This data is continuously fed into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, enabling the system to perform real-time BTPS (Body Temperature, Pressure, and Saturated) corrections. Why Environmental Accuracy Matters In pulmonary function testing, precision is paramount. Lung function is measured at a constant body temperature of 37°C. As exhaled air cools, its volume decreases; even a small temperature variance of 2°C can result in a 1% deviation in measured results. Furthermore, atmospheric pressure—which fluctuates significantly between sea level and high altitudes—and humidity levels directly impact gas volume and oxygen concentration. Without accurate, real-time correction for these variables, diagnostic data can be compromised. The Ambistik eliminates this risk by providing a continuous stream of ambient data, ensuring every measurement is standardised and clinically valid.

Description.value: The Ambistik CPET builds upon the foundation of the standard Ambistik module, providing a specialised solution for the rigorous demands of Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing. In addition to monitoring temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity, this advanced module features integrated, continuous measurement of ambient CO2 levels. Precision Performance in High-Activity Environments In a clinical or sports science environment, ambient CO2 levels are rarely static. Factors such as multiple people in a testing room or the high ventilatory output of an athlete during maximal exertion can significantly elevate local CO2 concentrations. By feeding real-time CO2 data directly into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, the Ambistik CPET compensates for these fluctuations instantly. This ensures that gas exchange calculations remain undisputed, protecting the clinician from data misinterpretation and ensuring the highest level of accuracy for every CPET measurement.

If the background levels are 10ppm for example, then when the person is taking a breath test this background reading of 10ppm will be taken into account, allowing any possible environmental exposure to be clearly identified. Environmental levels are displayed in PPM. It is widely accepted and acknowledged a non-smoker will perform a test and will display a level of 6ppm or less. A light smoker will perform a test and have a reading between 7 - 10ppm. A smoker will perform a test and have a reading of between 11 - 20ppm and a heavy smoker will display a reading of 21ppm or more.

Description.value: CO Screen complete with hard shell carry case. 6 sample SafeBreath mouthpieces, 9v PP3 battery, Calibration stem and operating manual. Carbon Monoxide is a colourless and odourless gas, making its presence difficult to detect. CO Screen has been designed to enable emergency service responders to carry out a simple breath test to establish carbon monoxide levels in a subject’s blood. When dealing with CO, time is critical. In the blood stream Carbon Monoxide has an affinity with haemoglobin some 200 times greater than Oxygen. When this happens, the blood is no longer able to carry oxygen, and this lack of oxygen causes the body's cells and tissue to die. CO Screen will give instant breath results in %COHb and PPM. Both measurements are backed up with colour traffic lights for immediate visual display. The new CO Screen, a rapid assessment of Carbon Monoxide poisoning for Emergency Services and First Emergency Responders.

Description.value: Respiratory assistance device for patients with spontaneous ventilation allowing maintenance in the airways of a pressure greater than atmospheric pressure during the entire respiratory cycle. The CPAP mode of ventilation allows: – to recruit collapsed alveoles – to restore a satisfactory level of functional residual capacity – to improve gas exchange at the level of the alveolocapillary membrane – to decrease pulmonary resistance – to decrease the work of breathing – to redistribute the alveolar liquid to the interstitial space in case of acute pulmonary oedema. The Boussignac CPAP and its manometer connector is a device for connection to a face mask with its 22 mm male connector, the crenellated upper part remaining open to the air. This device comprises 2 lateral ports: – the upper port is preconnected to an extension tube (length 200 cm) for connection to an air or oxygen source – the bottom port (colourless translucent) allows: . controlling pressure (use manometer code 527.01), . an additional oxygen supply if the gas administered to the patient via the upper port is air, . CO2 monitoring How it works: The gases administered to the patient (air, air-oxygen mixture or pure oxygen) pass through the extension tube and arrive in a circular chamber where the gases can only escape into the central zone passing through 4 micro-channels. At that moment, the injection speed of the gases is greatly increased. Deflectors at the exit site of the micro-channels eject the gases arriving at high speed towards the opposite wall. The collision of gas molecules between themselves generates a turbulence which creates a virtual valve and simultaneously the speed of gases is transformed in pressure. This pressure depends directly on the flowrate: if the flowrate (the amount of gas injected) is increased, the pressure will increase; if the flowrate is decreased, the pressure will decrease. N.B. Description.value: The Ergoselect 10 is a multifunctional, half-reclining ergometer designed to provide maximum safety and stability during stress testing. It is an ideal solution for elderly patients or those with physical limitations, offering a secure alternative to upright exercise. With a reclining surface that adjusts from a horizontal position up to a 45° angle, the system ensures optimal patient positioning for both diagnostic accuracy and comfort. Using a simple remote control, clinicians can electronically adjust the inclination and seat position to suit each patient. The device is uniquely versatile: with just a few simple adjustments, the ergometry unit can be folded away and the seat removed, instantly converting the system into a comfortable, high-quality examination couch. This dual-purpose design maximises clinic space without compromising on medical functionality.

Description.value: For suffers of chest congestion, the Flutter offers a simple and convenient method of bringing relief from discomfort. Excessive mucus in the lungs not only makes breathing more difficult, but leads to infection and lung damage. Stressful and strenuous coughing may help to clear obstructions, but this is not pleasant for the sufferer or relatives. A palm-sized device that requires no external power supply or batteries, the Flutter can be used at home, at work or on the go. The Flutter is recognised as an effective method to reduce the complications associated with excess mucus production. The user simply exhales a number of times into the mouthpiece of the Flutter causing the steel ball to vibrate in the casing. The pressure of the blowing against this steel ball and the vibrations that makes travel back into the lungs affects all the branches of the airways, loosening the mucus and moving into the larger airways where ordinary, gentle coughing becomes very effective in getting rid of it. For sufferers of; Chronic Bronchitis, Bronchiectasis, Emphsema, Asthma, Cystic Fibrosis. Not suitable for patients who suffer with; Pneumothorax, Severe Tuberculosis, Right Sided Heart Failure, Coughing Up Blood.

Description.value: M1 Mini Filters & Filter Cap Each filter pack contains two replacement fine filters for the M1 Mini Machine . These are disposable filters and can not be washed or reused. Depending on usage and the manufacturer’s recommendations, these filters should be replaced every 2 to 4 weeks. You can set the air filter reminder cycle on the LightTrip app to remind you when to replace your filter. To replace your filter: Slot the filter behind the round filter cap on the side of your device. The filter cap is designed to protect your air filter it is supplied with your device as standard, but should you need to replace the cap or would like a spare, this filter cap is suitable. What does a CPAP filter do? CPAP filters are designed to capture dust, pollen, and other airborne particles, allowing you to breathe in cleaner and healthier air throughout the night. By capturing airborne particles, these filters help reduce the risk of potential blockages. Please note: These filters are designed for the M1 Mini device and are incompatible with other models. If you require a new filter cap cover , you can purchase this separately.

Description.value: The motion cycle 100 med is a robust and medically certified ergometer that is easy to operate and includes the basic functions of a medical training device. It is always manufactured according to the medical directive (EU) 2017/745, class IIa and equipped with a coded pulse receiver, three training programmes, backlight and interface. The included quickstart programme is speed-dependent, the timed training is watt-constant and thus speed-independent. We also consider a pulse-controlled and therefore also speed-independent training programme to be essential for good endurance training. The valuable independence from the power grid avoids annoying tripping hazards and saves electricity. The unit is always equipped with a chip card reader so that training programmes can be stored on customer cards without a PC. The particularly small housing leaves enough space for easy access.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion body 900 is an indispensable component of holistic exercise therapy and integrated cardiovascular training. Specifically designed for active engagement of the upper extremities, this versatile system is ideal for both endurance training and the targeted mobilisation of the arms and shoulders following joint injuries or surgery. Exceptional Versatility and Ergonomics The drive unit features an extensive adjustment range, allowing the axle height to be perfectly positioned for both seated and standing training. The system supports both forward and backward movement, and the standard length-adjustable cranks can be quickly switched to a synchronous “handibike mode.” The asynchronous movement is excellent for shoulder joint and rotator cuff mobilisation, while the synchronous motion sequence is preferred for muscle building and is the optimal training mode for wheelchair users. To ensure maximum safety and comfort, the unit is equipped with Leki® grips. These feature a specialised click mechanism that allows for the use of hand straps or gloves, providing extra security for patients with limited grip strength.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion body 900 WM provides the full therapeutic power of our premier upper-body trainer in a specialised, wall-mounted configuration. Designed for facilities where space is at a premium, this model maintains all the advanced functionality of the standard motion body 900 while offering a significantly smaller footprint and unhindered access for wheelchair users. Maximum Functionality, Minimal Footprint The motion body 900 WM is the ideal solution for clinics that require a high degree of flexibility without occupying valuable floor space. With a simple, robust installation on any solid wall, the unit becomes a permanent, stable fixture for a wide range of patients. Its impressive 40 cm vertical adjustment range allows clinicians to quickly set the drive axle to the perfect height for seated patients, wheelchair users, or those performing standing exercises. Like its floor-mounted counterpart, it features the ability to switch between asynchronous and synchronous “handibike” modes, ensuring it can handle everything from delicate joint mobilisation to intensive muscle-building protocols.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion cross 900 is designed to engage the entire body, making it an ideal solution for activating patients with sedentary lifestyles or those requiring low-impact cardiovascular conditioning. Its guided movement pattern ensures a safe and immediate start to training, promoting an upright posture while coordinating upper and lower body movement for maximum therapeutic benefit. Ergonomic Motion and Clinical Safety The system features long cranks and an ergonomic linkage between arm and leg movements, creating a smooth, sweeping stride that mimics natural motion. Unlike many other cross-trainers on the market, the motion cross 900 is engineered for joint-friendly performance and whisper-quiet operation. With its intuitive interface and easy-to-learn movement, the device allows patients to train effectively with minimal supervision, optimising staff resources. Furthermore, the exceptionally low step-on height of just 18 cm makes it one of the most accessible machines in its class for clinical rehabilitation.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion cycle 900 has been meticulously engineered with a focus on biomechanical excellence, meeting the rigorous requirements for both clinical rehabilitation and athletic performance. Designed to provide an optimal, individualized training position, it ensures that every user—regardless of physical stature or mobility—can train safely and effectively. Maximum Accessibility and Ergonomic Flexibility Recognizing the needs of patients with restricted mobility, the motion cycle 900 features a compact housing that allows for a wide, low step-through of approximately 36–41 cm. This deep-axle design ensures effortless mounting and dismounting. The system is highly inclusive, accommodating a vast range of users from children (starting at 135 cm) to tall adults (up to 205 cm). With a narrow Q-factor of no more than 18 cm and a wide range of horizontal and vertical adjustments, the motion cycle 900 provides a natural, joint-friendly pedaling motion tailored to the individual.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion relax 900 is a premium recumbent training system engineered for comfort during extended sessions. It is specifically designed to meet the needs of patients with neurological or orthopedic restrictions, as well as those requiring a higher weight capacity. By prioritising ergonomic support, the motion relax 900 ensures that even the most challenging rehabilitation goals remain accessible and safe. Enhanced Accessibility and Specialised Support This latest development features an extended step-through area and a narrow, joint-friendly Q-factor to promote natural movement. To ensure the safety of every patient, the unit is equipped with robust support handles for easy mounting and dismounting, alongside a standard adjustable backrest for personalised lumbar support. For bariatric care, the “Boosted 250” version offers an expanded swivel seat and high-positioned armrests, facilitating easier access and supporting a maximum user weight of 250 kg.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion sprint 900 PL is the result of decades of development and close collaboration between leading research institutions and elite sports organisations. This high-performance treadmill is designed to meet the rigorous demands of professional users, delivering a platform where clinical accuracy meets the intensity of competitive sports diagnostics. High-Torque Performance and Cushioned Stability Equipped with a powerful motor system, the motion sprint 900 PL ensures exceptional synchronisation and highly precise, reproducible speed regulation. Unlike the lamella models, the PL utilises a high-quality nubbed tread belt, specifically engineered to provide superior cushioning and joint protection during high-intensity sessions. This ensures that even at peak performance, the impact on the patient’s or athlete’s musculoskeletal system is minimised. Bespoke Customisation for Specialised Care The motion sprint 900 PL is uniquely versatile, offering a vast array of specialised accessories to suit diverse clinical and athletic needs. From reinforced handrails and forearm supports to safety brackets for fall protection, the system can be tailored to provide a secure environment for any user. Additionally, the option for running direction reversal and integrated communication interfaces makes this treadmill a professional-grade tool for highly specialised diagnostic applications.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: Here is the edited copy for the motion sprint 900 SE, maintaining the professional and clinical tone consistent with your treadmill range while clearly distinguishing its specific feature set. The motion sprint 900 SE: Professional Slat-Technology for Level-Ground Training The motion sprint 900 SE is a robust, professional-grade treadmill featuring advanced lamella (slat) technology. Engineered for clinics and training facilities that require a high-performance, flat-surface running environment, the SE model provides the same exceptional joint protection and mechanical precision as the rest of the 900 series. Superior Impact Absorption and Mechanical Efficiency The running surface is composed of 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the lamellas to react dynamically to every step, creating a “swing” effect that significantly reduces impact forces on the patient’s joints. The low-friction design of the slat system ensures remarkably smooth synchronisation and allows for consistent operation at ultra-low speeds starting from just 0.1 km/h—ideal for early-stage gait training and neurological rehabilitation. While this specific model is designed for level-ground exercise (no inclination), it offers a standard speed range up to 17.0 km/h, with an optional performance package available to reach 22 km/h.

manufacturer:Love Medical.name: Love Medical
manufacturer:Love Medical.authority: The manufacturer's own words about its own product. Not independently verified.

Description.value: The motion sprint 900 SL is a robust, high-performance treadmill engineered with advanced lamella (slat) technology. Designed for both clinical rehabilitation and professional athletic training, it provides a superior running surface that prioritises joint protection and mechanical precision. Advanced Lamella Engineering for Joint Protection At the heart of the motion sprint 900 SL are 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the running surface to “swing” freely and respond dynamically to every footfall. The result is a highly shock-absorbent surface that optimally protects the patient’s joints while ensuring smooth synchronisation even at low motor power. This low-friction design is particularly beneficial for delicate rehabilitation, as it enables smooth, consistent operation at speeds as low as 0.1 km/h. For higher-intensity diagnostics, the system supports speeds up to 17.0 km/h as standard, with an optional performance package increasing the maximum speed to 22 km/h.

Description.value: The motion stair 900 is the final component in our comprehensive equipment line, specifically designed to bridge the gap between clinical exercise therapy and functional everyday movement. By simulating the natural action of climbing stairs, it provides a highly effective platform for simultaneous cardiovascular conditioning, muscular strengthening, and the advancement of coordinative skills. Versatile Motion and Enhanced Patient Safety Unlike traditional steppers, the motion stair 900 utilises a pedal-independent system. This allows for a vast variety of movement amplitudes and specialised work tasks, making it an essential tool for training balance and motor coordination. To ensure the system is accessible to the widest possible patient demographic, the frame features a newly designed handrail. This ergonomic support provides a higher degree of security, extending the device’s application to users with compromised balance or weaker coordination. Furthermore, the entry point has been optimised for safer and easier access, ensuring patient confidence from the very start of the session.

Description.value: The NeuroLight Pupillometer elevates neurological assessment with its non-invasive and objective approach. This innovative tool automates pupillometry, a crucial technique for evaluating neurological function. By providing accurate measurements of pupil size and light reflex, NeuroLight empowers clinicians to gain early insights into a patient’s neurological state. This translates to faster diagnosis, more informed treatment decisions, and ultimately, improved patient outcomes. The portable pupilometer features an easy-to-use interface and a comfortable, reusable eye cup. It precisely measures pupil size and response time, converting them into a clear QPI score. This allows for the identification of potential neurological issues, with patient data being logged, tracked and transferable for further analysis. Learn More Read Support Literature Pupil Reactivity Assessment with NeuroLight QPI Score This chart translates pupillary response, measured by the NeuroLight device, into a clear and objective QPI score (Quantitative Pupillometry Index). Score Range Red – 0-1-2: Non-Reactive / Weak – May suggest significant neurological dysfunction. Orange – 3: Reduced – May indicate potential neurological issues. Green – 4-5: Good / Very Good – Considered normal pupillary response. Product No Product Description NPC Code D85.500 Neurolight Pupilometer N/A

Description.value: Oscimed Anti Snoring PosiForm Belt The Oscimed Anti Snoring PosiForm Belt is an at home snoring solution and an effective Positional Obstructive Sleep Apnoea (POSA) treatment. Snoring is most likely to happen while sleeping on your back, as the muscles in the throat relax and drop, causing snoring sounds and airway obstructions. The device produces small vibrations to stop you from sleeping on your back, preventing obstructions. The belt is adjustable to fit most and is made with a gentle, lightweight, breathable fabric preventing perspiration and is designed to be worn across the waist or chest. The device has two clips that allow it to be worn without a belt, directly on an undergarment. Using the belt When the device detects you are sleeping on your back, it produces small vibrations with brief intervals until you return to sleeping on your side. The small electronic device is attached to a comfortable, adjustable belt which can be worn on the waist or chest while sleeping. With 7 settings, the vibration level can be easily adjusted for your comfort. Benefits of the PosiForm Anti Snore Belt Trains patients to sleep in healthy positions comfortably Effective snoring and POSA treatment Comfortable, customisable and easy to wear Adjustable and adaptable The simple to use belt can be easily adjusted to your preferred vibration intensity. Simply press the middle button and adjust to your required intensity. The adaptable device can be set to a higher level for those who sleep very deeply or those with a higher BMI. The PosiForm anti snoring belt is available in a universal size, with an elasticated adjustable strap to fit to your shape: The fabric belt size is recommended for waist circumferences of 70-125 centimetres. Ideal for Positional Sleep Apnoea patients The device is a reliable treatment option for those with Positional Sleep Apnoea (POSA). Description.value: Bivona ™ FlexTend ™ TTS ™ Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes Bivona ™ FlexTend ™ TTS ™ Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes Why Select Portex Bivona FlexTend TTS Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes? Bivona FlexTend TTS Tracheostomy Tubes are designed for neonatal and paediatric patients who require intermittent or temporary cuff use. A cuff, when inflated, helps create a seal between the tube’s outer wall and the trachea to direct airflow through the inner lumen, protecting against aspiration and optimising respiration in ventilated patients and patients performing lung expansion therapies. When the seal is no longer needed, the cuff can be deflated, and it rests Tight-to-Shaft (TTS), reducing the risk of trauma to the trachea and allowing the patient to speak. ¹ ' ² Bivona FlexTend TTS Tracheostomy Tubes can be reprocessed up to five times and are made of soft, natural, biocompatible silicone that is intended to be gentle on sensitive body tissues. Description.value: Universal QTube CPAP Muffler Kit If you find your mask and tube noisy, then a QTube CPAP Muffler can help. The QTube muffler effectively reduces noise from airflow turbulence in the tubing, lowering the sound levels of your CPAP therapy by 50–80%. This universal kit is compatible with AirSense 10, AirSense 11, BMC G3, Philips DreamStation, Philips DreamStation 2, SleepStyle, Prisma and BMC M1 Mini. AirMini user will need an additional universal hose adapter (sold separately above) with the QTube. Please note that QTube will not reduce noise from the machine itself or any whistling noise from the CPAP mask’s exhalation port. It is intended to reduce noise from the tubing and mask. How it works The muffler attaches between your device and the tubing with a short 8-inch flex tube. It then reduces the noise using an internal foam layer that can be removed and replaced. The QTube Muffler contains the muffler and a short tube to connect it to the CPAP machine. Your regular hose then connects to the other end of the muffler. The muffler filter needs to be replaced after two weeks of continuous use (not sold at Intus). IMPORTANT: The CPAP Muffler should not be used with a water-based humidifier, as the filter inside may become saturated. However, most humidifiers act as a muffler anyway, so this would not be required when using one.

Description.value: Here is the edited copy for your Bronchial Challenge System, maintaining the professional, high-precision, and clinical tone established for your pulmonary diagnostic range. Bronchial Challenge System: Precision and Safety in Provocation Testing This compact, microprocessor-controlled compressor unit is specifically designed to perform standardised bronchial challenge testing with the highest degree of accuracy. Featuring a medically certified, integrated air compressor, the system operates independently of any external air source, making it a versatile and self-contained solution for modern pulmonary laboratories. Automated Workflow and Clinical Compliance The system is engineered to fulfil all international standards for automated pulmonary testing routines. An integrated LCD screen provides the clinician with real-time information and guides the user through predefined test sequences, ensuring high reproducibility and a streamlined workflow. The low-noise operation of the built-in compressor ensures a calm environment, helping to keep the patient relaxed throughout the provocation protocol. Superior Hygiene and Environmental Protection Patient safety and hygiene are at the forefront of this system’s design. It utilises an advanced 3-way valve system that directs patient airflow precisely, preventing the exhaled air from contaminating the side stream nebuliser and the provocation liquid. Additionally, the system features integrated filtration for exhaled air, protecting the clinical environment and ensuring that both the patient and staff can breathe safely without risk of cross-contamination.

Description.value: Maximise Comfort with a CPAP Chin Strap Chin straps are great for making sure you breathe through your nose and to avoid a dry mouth. The strap is made from a soft and slightly padded neoprene fabric. Around 40% of CPAP users suffer from mouth leaks. The Universal CPAP Chin Strap from CPAPHero is a One-Size-Fits-All design, made of a stretchy, breathable material and is worn over the head and under the chin. The strap is adjustable, so it can be tightened or loosened to achieve a secure and comfortable fit. Please note that chin straps are designed to complement CPAP therapy. On their own, they do not treat snoring or Sleep Apnoea. Optimises Comfort & Reduce Leaks An affordable way to instantly get a better night’s sleep. People generally notice the effectiveness after just one night of using one. A reduction in air leaks escaping from the mouth can instantly improve your CPAP therapy experience. Suitable for use with any nasal pillows or nasal cushion masks. Please note: These are only to be used with a CPAP machine; these are not for treating or preventing snoring.
